actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: FurnitureSim-v0 is registered with entry point furniture_bench.envs.furniture_sim_env:FurnitureSimEnv
FurnitureSimEnv is the gym.Env subclass of the simulator
The default visual observation lists ee_pos, ee_quat, ee_pos_vel, ee_ori_vel, gripper_width, color_image1 and color_image2
For the quat rotation representation the action is an end-effector delta of 8 numbers [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw, gripper]; rot_6d uses 10 numbers and axis uses 7
The action space is a Box with every element from -1 to 1 and shape (num_envs, pose_dim + 1)
pose_dim is 7 for quat, 9 for rot_6d and 6 for axis
step clips the action to the bounds of the action space before applying it
The default maximum number of environment steps is 3000
An environment is done when its step count exceeds the furniture's max_env_steps
The observation space is a Dict with a nested robot_state Dict (unless concat_robot_state is True) and one Box per colour image
The robot-state dimensions are ee_pos 3, ee_quat 4, ee_pos_vel 3, ee_ori_vel 3, joint_positions 7, joint_velocities 7, joint_torques 7 and gripper_width 1
The resized camera image is (224, 224) pixels
The full-resolution camera image is (1280, 720) pixels
step returns a four-tuple (observation, reward, done, info)
reset returns the observation
The reward is computed from the furniture assembly state
The robot control frequency is 10 Hz
The Isaac Gym simulation timestep is 1/60 s with 2 substeps
step derives the number of simulator refreshes from the control frequency, the timestep and the substeps
A positive gripper action closes the gripper and a negative one opens it to max_gripper_width
max_gripper_width is 0.065 for the square_table furniture
squeeze_batch_dim defaults to False, so observations keep the leading environment dimension

determinism.notes: reset(seed) repeats the fake's initial pose jitter and every transition; the fake uses Python's random.Random while the upstream engine uses Isaac Gym PhysX with GPU physics, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: no dynamics: the fake moves the end effector kinematically and has no rigid-body physics, contacts, friction, gravity, actuator, joint or sensor model; the upstream simulator is Isaac Gym PhysX (F1), not this F0 model

the image observations are placeholder 2 x 2 x 3 arrays; the configured real sizes are 224 x 224 when resize_img is True and 1280 x 720 at full resolution, and the fake models no camera, lighting or depth
rotation is not modelled (the ee_quat stays the identity and the quaternion part of the action has no effect) and the assembly check and parts_poses reward are not modelled; the reward is always 0
one environment per instance: num_envs > 1 is not modelled and the action space always has shape (1, 8)
the fake returns one observation per environment (no batch dimension), while the upstream environment keeps a leading dimension because squeeze_batch_dim defaults to False
no rendering, viewer, video recording or GPU simulation
the fake was not compared with the upstream Isaac Gym environment: Isaac Gym is not installed and needs a Linux GPU machine, so the sim backend was not run
reset initial-pose randomization ranges are not modelled; the fake adds a small placeholder jitter to a fixed kinematic pose

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state stays readable
